gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Audiowide lays out futuristic letters like tiles with wide grout between them, every curve drawn with no swelling or thinning. And Noto Sans Avestan is the plain sans that follows, modern and clean, with a pronounced x-height and curve tips that stop short of touching.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-vend-sans: Bold and expressive, Autour One runs a clear channel into every round letter. Vend Sans takes over with a ruler-drawn line and open curve endings, so it does the quiet work of carrying text while the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-stack-sans-text: Goldman spreads its commanding letters wide, round forms curving like open parentheses. Stack Sans Text follows with a marker-like constant line and big-bodied lowercase, so paragraphs would move along smoothly, modern and unfussy, with curve endings kept well apart.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-tiktok-sans: Loud, round and unashamed: Grandstander keeps its diagonals as thick as its uprights and its shapes held open. The pair's strongest quality is how TikTok Sans lets that noise settle.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-questrial: Questrial reads smooth and modern, its open c, e and s shapes cut flat like stencils with one weight throughout. Autour One brings the bold voice on top.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada keeps a steady line with no pressure variation, and its c, s and z stand full and clear. Under Grandstander's bold headings, a long page would read smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic reads big and open, with a large x-height and curves that never close back on themselves. And Flavors, whimsical and commanding, gives it a lively head, so a longer passage would feel modern and easy to keep following.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Happy Monkey sets a ruler-straight line weight and wide gaps in the e, bold and a bit odd. Be Vietnam Pro sits below with a higher mean line and curve endings that never crowd each other.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-epilogue: Wide gaps in the e and a ruler-straight line mark Happy Monkey as bold and distinctive. And Epilogue brings its curvy, wire-like monoline letters, so the two feel loose and approachable together.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-merriweather-sans: One stroke thickness runs through every Happy Monkey letter, giving the heading a bold, distinctive look. And Merriweather Sans sits beneath it with a sturdy, large lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right.
